# Glacier Air — company brief

Glacier Air is a family-owned air conditioning, refrigeration and mechanical services contractor based in Osborne Park, Western Australia. We work across Perth, the South West and the Great Southern.

This file is for people and AI assistants. Facts only — no invented statistics or 24/7 claims.

## Contact

- Legal / trading name: Glacier Air
- Website: https://glacierair.com.au
- Phone: (08) 9242 3111
- Email: service@glacierair.com.au
- Address: U10/28 Frobisher St, Osborne Park WA 6017, Australia
- ARC Licence: AU18839
- AIRAH member
- HIA member

## Services

- Commercial air conditioning — design, installation, service and maintenance
- Residential air conditioning — design, installation, service and maintenance
- Commercial refrigeration — design, installation, service and maintenance
- Winery glycol refrigeration — design, installation, service and maintenance
- Ammonia refrigeration service and maintenance
- Mechanical services — commercial exhaust, fresh air, compliance and certification
- Hire air conditioning and hire chillers
- Panasonic ASC warranty agent and repairs. Panasonic Specialist Air Network dealer.

## Recent project types (from the public site)

- Office AC fitouts (e.g. Fremantle)
- Winery and barn AC / chiller upgrades
- Food production and cold storage
- Commercial and regional HVAC installs
